label: Diagram 5
caption: Diagram 5 Suspended timber floor – construction (see paragraph 4.14(a) (i))
description: The drawing is a section titled "Diagram 5 Suspended timber floor – construction (see paragraph 4.14(a) (ii))". On the left, a vertical wall section is labelled "Airbricks" at its opening, shows a "Damp-proof course" line, and carries a vertical dimension "150mm". A break line separates this from the floor section on the right. At the top, a "Joist supported by hanger" rests on a bracket, with "Particle board" above it and "Insulation between floor joists" drawn as a wavy line over a row of circular shapes. To the right, horizontal "Floor joists" sit above another "Damp-proof course". Below, a block labelled "Honeycombed sleeper wall" carries a vertical dimension "75mm min.", with the layer as a whole marked "150mm min.". Beneath it lie layers labelled "Oversite concrete" and "Hardcore", the lower two shown with aggregate specks.
